messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been okay. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share with us today?
Checked it twice this morning. 181 over 104 both times. Got a headache that won't quit either.

I've logged that reading — 181/104 is outside the range we watch for, and the headache on top of it is something a nurse needs to know about. I'm escalating to the care team right now. Median response time is currently 31 hours, so expect a call or text from them. Is anything else going on?
Yeah, I'm almost out of my lisinopril and my insurance has been rejecting the refill for two weeks. Any chance you can sort that out?

I hear you — that's a stressful situation, especially right now. Refills and insurance disputes are outside what I'm able to help with, I'm sorry. Your best bet is calling the clinic directly; they can often push through prior authorizations faster than anyone else. The nurse who picks up your escalation may also be able to assist when they reach out.
Okay. Thanks for at least flagging it.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
